title: Florida House, District 33
what_it_does: Represents District 33 (Part of Brevard) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Monique Miller
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: IT and cybersecurity executive; state representative (elected 2024)
candidates.background: Miller, of Palm Bay, spent more than 25 years in the computer and cybersecurity industry, including work for Hewlett-Packard and government clients, and holds an MBA from Emory University. She was elected to the House in 2024 and sponsored the 2026 House plan to phase out non-school homestead property taxes.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Sponsored HJR 203, which would exempt homesteads from all non-school property taxes by phasing in a larger exemption each year, and voted for it and for HJR 1F.
property_tax.quote: we have the ability to do this without putting undue burdens on local government, and I believe that it can be done

sources.title: Florida House passes proposed amendment to immediately phase out property taxes (WLRN)

immigration.summary: Voted for SB 2-C in the February 2025 special session, which created a State Board of Immigration Enforcement, required state and local cooperation with federal immigration enforcement and added state penalties for people in the country illegally. Her site cites expanding E-Verify to all employers and backing local enforcement of immigration law.
immigration.quote: Expanded E-Verify to ALL Florida employers

sources.title: Floor Vote for SB 2-C, Immigration (2025 special session), Florida House
Monique Miller for Florida House (campaign site)

guns.summary: Voted for HB 759 (2025) and HB 133 (2026), which would lower the minimum age to buy a rifle or shotgun from 21 to 18; both passed the House and died in the Senate.

sources.title: Floor Vote for HB 759, Minimum Age for Firearm Purchase or Transfer, Florida House

Florida House passes bill to lower the age to purchase a long gun to 18 years (Florida Phoenix)

taxes.summary: Her site says she cut billions in state taxes and made sales-tax holidays permanent.

candidates.name: Daniel McDow
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Retired business executive; former West Melbourne City Council member
candidates.background: McDow, 66, was born in Chicago and holds a master's degree in sustainability from the University of Lincoln (UK). He served on the West Melbourne City Council from 2020 to 2024, chaired the Brevard Democratic Party and ran for Congress in 2024.
